user.title: Connect to tripmate
user.description: Enter the address of the tripmate web UI, including any base path. For example: {example_url}

data_description.username: Only needed when tripmate sits behind a reverse proxy that asks for HTTP basic auth.
data_description.password: The password that goes with the username.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure tripmate
reconfigure.description: Enter the new address of the tripmate web UI, including any base path. For example: {example_url}

data_description.username: Only needed when tripmate sits behind a reverse proxy that asks for HTTP basic auth.
data_description.password: The password that goes with the username.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to tripmate again
reauth_confirm.description: The credentials for {url} were refused. Enter ones the reverse proxy in front of tripmate accepts.

error.invalid_url: Enter an http:// or https:// URL without credentials or a query string.
error.username_required: A password needs a username to go with it.
error.invalid_auth: The username and password were refused.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to tripmate at that address.
error.invalid_response: Something answered at that address, but it does not look like tripmate.

abort.already_configured: This tripmate instance is already configured.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The tripmate address has been updated.
